title: Third Shot Drop Tres Idiomas
style: modern reggaeton viral pop, dembow rhythm, punchy 808s, trap hi-hats, tropical synth lead, female lead with male hype ad-libs, three-language verse rotation, pickleball coaching anthem, club ready, 96 bpm, viral hook
lyrics:
[Intro]
Third shot drop, third shot drop
Soft over the net, do not let it pop

[Verse 1 — English]
Serve goes deep, return comes back
Now you are at the line, ready to attack
But do not bang it, do not slam
Third shot drop is the secret plan
Low trajectory, soft little arc
Lands in the zone, hits the mark

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
Third shot drop, tercer tiro suave, sān pāi qiāo
Soft over the net, suave por encima, qiāo guò wǎng
Move up the court, sube hacia el frente, wǎng qián zǒu
Third shot drop, tercer tiro suave, sān pāi qiāo

[Verse 2 — Español]
No le pegues fuerte, dale suavecito
Arco pequeñito, vuelo cortito
Cae en la cocina, no se levanta
Tercer tiro suave, eso te encanta
Muévete al frente, controla el partido
Tercer tiro suave, te lo he prometido

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
Third shot drop, tercer tiro suave, sān pāi qiāo
Soft over the net, suave por encima, qiāo guò wǎng
Move up the court, sube hacia el frente, wǎng qián zǒu
Third shot drop, tercer tiro suave, sān pāi qiāo

[Verse 3 — 中文]
Fā qiú shēn, huí qiú guò
Bú yào měng dǎ, qiāo qiao tuô
Dī kōng fēi xíng, qiāng qiāo guò wǎng
Luò zài jiă chú bù fǎn cháng
Xiàng qián yí dòng, kòng zhì qiú chǎng
Sān pāi qiāo, nǐ huì yí diàn liàng

[Bridge]
Do not bang, do not slam
No golpees, sigue el plan
Bú yào měng dǎ, gēn zhe jì huà
Third shot drop, the soft hands play
Tercer tiro suave, gana el día
Sān pāi qiāo, shěng lì liàng

[Outro]
Third shot drop, tercer tiro suave, sān pāi qiāo
Viral viral, viral viral
Third shot drop, tercer tiro suave, sān pāi qiāo
